uccaya.p: [U+ci+a] (pu) CL=7 [Uccayanaṃ uccayo. Rū,nhā-351] (A) Prosperity, Learning. (B) A pile (or) the mass. See - Uccayaggāha.

B:
uccaya： uccaya（pu）
